name: system-secret-capture-request
description: Mint a one-time, single-use, 30-minute link for the user to enter a SYSTEM secret during setup — an API key or channel credential (e.g. the Anthropic API key). The target name must be a secret declared by a skill or a known channel credential key. The value goes straight to the vault; you never see it. Setup-wizard only.

inputs.secret_name: string (the EXACT vault key to capture, e.g. 'anthropic_api_key' or 'channel.email.nylas_api_key')
inputs.label: string? (text shown to the user on the form; defaults to the secret_name)

outputs.capture_url: string (the one-time link to send the user)
outputs.expires_at: string (local ISO timestamp when the link expires)
outputs.secret_name: string (the vault key the value will be stored under)
